page.overview:
Who is Chuck Armstrong?

Chuck Armstrong is a minor character in Cars. He is a dark blue Axxelo/Fission. He races for the sponsor "Mood Springs." He suffers from slight allergies to certain fuels.

"Chuck Armstrong has always had a slight allergy to certain fuels. As a result those fuels make it a little difficult for him to be within a five foot radius of them. Once he started racing professionally, not only did the problem not go away, it actually got worse at high speeds. It got so bad the other cars didn't want to pass him. Chuck hopes he's a good example of how a problem can be an asset."

During a race at Motor Speedway of the South, he was part of a big wreck that caused him to get pulled out of the race by Tow.

Chuck Armstrong appears in Cars: The Video Game, with the name Banks. In Palm Mile Speedway, he finished in 17th place; in Motor Speedway of the South, he finished in 17th place; in Sun Valley International Speedway, he finished in 17th place; in Smasherville International Speedway, he finished in 17th place and in Los Angeles International Speedway, he finished in 17th place.
